chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Abū Jamīlah, from Abān ibn Taghlib, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man who married a woman, and she did not remain, after she had been brought to him, except four months before she gave birth to a girl. He denied her child, while she claimed that she had conceived from him. So he said: “That is not accepted from her. If they bring the dispute before the ruler, they shall engage in mutual imprecation, they shall be separated, and she will never be lawful for him again.”

key_terms.أُهْدِيَتْ: was brought to her husband after marriage
key_terms.تَرَافَعَا: they brought the dispute for adjudication
key_terms.لَا يُقْبَلُ: is not accepted as a valid claim

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman gives birth four months after marriage and the husband denies the child?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning a dispute over paternity when a woman gives birth only four months after marriage. The Imam عليه السلام rules that her claim is not accepted in this case, and if the case is taken to the authority, liʿān is carried out, permanent separation follows, and remarriage between them is barred.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4642 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Jameelah from Aban ibn Taghlib who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who married a woman, and after being brought to him, she gave birth to a girl in only four months.
He denied that the child was his, while she claimed that she had conceived from him.
Imam (as) said: "Her claim is not accepted. If they take the matter to the ruler, they must both engage in mutual cursing (lian), and they will be separated, and she will never be permissible for him again."
